- Cake or cupcakes — $60

- Photographer / photo print supplies (volunteer + disposable prints) — $60  
- Favors/prizes (stickers, ribbons, small toys) — $50  
- Invitations / printing or digital invites — $20

- Chaperone appreciation (snacks / coffee) — $30

- Use digital invites only → save ~$20
